managedBillingEnabled.description: When true, the Managed Billing feature is enabled for this practice, meaning the billing mode is set to `managed`. The practice owner can centrally configure billing settings that apply across all team members. This is a computed, read-only field. See [Setting Up Managed Billing for Your Team](https://help.practicebetter.io/hc/en-us/articles/50826847092507-Setting-Up-Managed-Billing-for-Your-Team).

name.description: The official business or practice name, as entered in the Company Profile. This name appears on invoices, forms, and other client-facing documents.

dateCreated.description: The date and time the consultant record was created.

dateModified.description: The date and time the consultant record was last modified. Null if not set.

id.description: The unique identifier of the user.

isOwner.description: True if the consultant is the owner of the company account, false if not, null if not determined.

isPractitioner.description: True if the consultant is a practitioner, false if not, null if not determined.

defaultCurrency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code set as this consultant's default for invoicing and billing (e.g. `usd` `cad` `gbp`). Null if not set.

timeZone.description: The consultant's configured time zone. Defaults to Eastern Standard Time when not set.

title.description: The consultant's title. Possible values are `Mr` `Mr.` `Ms` `Ms.` `Mrs` `Mrs.` `Miss` `Dr` `Dr.` `Prof` `Prof.`, or a custom value. Null if not set.

currency.description: The currency of the invoice amounts.

dateCreated.description: UTC timestamp when the invoice was created.

dateModified.description: UTC timestamp when the invoice was last modified.

delayedPaymentHistory.description: A list of the delayed payments (such as bank debits) recorded against the invoice. Entries may be in progress, failed or successful; successful entries also appear in `paymentHistory`.

notes.description: Notes.

description.description: A free-text description of the invoice. Null or empty if no description has been set.

discountDescription.description: The label for the invoice discount. Set to the coupon code when a coupon is applied to the invoice.

discountPercent.description: The discount rate as a percentage of the subtotal. Used only when `discountAmount` is null or zero. Null if no discount percentage has been set.

hasManagedBilling.description: When true, the invoice has managed billing settings with a billing mode of managed.

hasRecentFailedDelayedPayment.description: When true, the most recent delayed payment (such as a bank debit) on the invoice failed and no later payment has been recorded.

id.description: The unique identifier of the invoice.

includeSignature.description: When true, the practitioner's saved signature is included on the invoice. Has no effect if the practitioner has no saved signature.

invoiceDate.description: UTC timestamp of the date shown on the invoice.

invoiceFooter.description: The footer text for the invoice. Null or empty if no footer has been set.

lineItems.description: A list of the line items billed on the invoice.

id.description: Id.

paymentHistory.description: A list of the payments recorded against the invoice.

notes.description: Notes.

id.description: Id.

timeZone.description: Timezone.

paymentStatus.description: The payment status of the invoice. Possible values are `unpaid` `partial` `paid`.

publishStatus.description: The publish status of the invoice. Possible values are `autodraft` `draft` `published`.

refundable.description: When true, at least one payment in `paymentHistory` has not been refunded.

revision.description: The revision number of the invoice, incremented each time the invoice is changed.

taxDescription.description: The label for the invoice-level tax. An invoice-level tax only applies when this is non-empty and either `taxPercent` or `taxAmount` is set.

taxPercent.description: The invoice-level tax rate as a percentage, applied to the subtotal after discount. Ignored when any line item has its own tax. Null if no tax percentage has been set.

writeOffHistory.description: A list of the write-offs recorded against the invoice.

notes.description: Notes.

next_cursor.description: Next page cursor; empty when there are no more pages.

parameters.description: The ID of the consultant whose profile to retrieve. Omit to return the authenticated consultant's own profile. Requires the settings:read privilege on the target consultant when provided.
parameters.name: as_consultant

activationStatus.description: The activation state of this consultant account. Possible values are `activated` `deactivated` `archived` `unactivated`. `activated` ,  account is fully active. `deactivated` ,  subscription payments are past due. `archived` ,  deactivated and excluded from team plan seat limits; cannot be self-restored. `unactivated` ,  account is pending purge and no longer accessible.

businessNumber.description: The practice's business registration or tax number (e.g. GST number, QST number, VAT number, EIN). This number appears on Practice Better billing statements. Null if not set.

businessNumberType.description: The type of business number stored in `BusinessNumber` (e.g. `GST`, `HST`, `EIN`). Null if no business number is set.

dateCreated.description: UTC timestamp when this practice was created in Practice Better.

id.description: The unique identifier of the practice company.

managedBillingEnabled.description: When true, the Managed Billing feature is enabled for this practice, meaning the billing mode is set to `managed`. The practice owner can centrally configure billing settings that apply across all team members. This is a computed, read-only field. See [Setting Up Managed Billing for Your Team](https://help.practicebetter.io/hc/en-us/articles/50826847092507-Setting-Up-Managed-Billing-for-Your-Team).

name.description: The official business or practice name, as entered in the Company Profile. This name appears on invoices, forms, and other client-facing documents.

dateCreated.description: UTC timestamp when this consultant account was created.

dateModified.description: UTC timestamp when this consultant record was last modified. Null if the record has never been updated since creation.

emailAddress.description: The email address associated with this user's Practice Better account.

id.description: The unique identifier of the user.

isAssistant.description: When true, this consultant is an administrative user (assistant). Admin users can create and manage resources on behalf of a practitioner but cannot own client records directly.

isOwner.description: When true, this consultant is the team owner. A practice has exactly one owner, who is the primary account holder and receives all billing statements.

isPractitioner.description: When true, this consultant is a practitioner. Practitioners (e.g. a Nutritionist or Health Coach) can create and manage their own resources, including bookings, forms, session notes, and protocols. When false, this is an administrative user.

afterHoursBookingsDisabled.description: True when default booking slots (9:00 AM to 5:00 PM in the practitioner's time zone) are not offered on days when the practitioner has no availability, so clients can only request times within configured availability. False when clients can request one-on-one sessions on days with no availability, using those default slots. Group services never get default slots. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `false`.

externalAllDayEventsIncluded.description: True when all-day events on the connected external calendar block availability for the entire day. False when all-day events do not block availability. Null when not set.

externalAvailabilityEnabled.description: True when the consultant's connected external calendar blocks availability ,  busy time on that calendar marks those slots as unbookable. False when the external calendar does not affect availability. Null when not set.

isOutOfOffice.description: True if the consultant is currently out of office (i.e. `currentOutOfOfficePeriod` is non-null). False otherwise.

lookBusyDistribution.description: Controls the distribution strategy used when hiding slots for the look-busy feature. Possible values are `early` (presents the earliest slots first) `later` (presents the latest slots first) `even` (distributes hidden slots evenly across the day). Null if not configured.

lookBusyFloor.description: The minimum number of available slots that must always remain bookable, regardless of the look-busy percentage. Must be between `1` and `10`. Null if not configured.

lookBusyPercentage.description: The percentage of available booking slots that are artificially marked as unavailable to create the appearance of a busy calendar. Must be a multiple of 10 between `10` and `90`. Null if the look-busy feature is not enabled.

rollingTimeSlotsEnabled.description: True when booking slots are generated with overlapping windows (e.g. 6:00, 6:30, 6:10, 6:40). False when booking slots are generated as consecutive non-overlapping blocks (e.g. 6:00, 6:30, 6:30, 7:00). Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `false`.

sessionRequestBuffer.description: The minimum number of hours required between the current time and the start of a bookable time slot. Prevents clients from booking within this window. Null if not configured.

sessionRequestThreshold.description: The maximum number of days into the future that clients can book a session. Null if no advance booking limit is configured.

timeSlotRounding.description: The time slot interval (in minutes) to which available booking times are rounded. Possible values are `5` `10` `15` `20` `30` `60`. Null uses the default (`15`).

bio.description: The consultant's full biography displayed on their public profile page. Null if not set.

bookingPageRedirectUri.description: A URL to redirect clients to after they complete a booking. Overrides any product-level redirect. Null if no redirect is configured.

bookingsPages.description: The list of bookings pages configured for this practitioner, each defining the services, layout, and audience restrictions for a client-facing booking experience.

calendarSlotDuration.description: The duration in minutes of each time slot shown in the calendar grid. Possible values are `10` `15` `30`. Null uses the default (`15`).

calendarViewConsultantId.description: For assistant accounts, the ID of the practitioner whose calendar is shown by default when opening the calendar view. Null defaults to the first practitioner on the team who is not an assistant.

cancellationMessage.description: The cancellation policy text displayed to clients when they attempt to cancel or reschedule.

cancellationMessageEnabled.description: True when a cancellation policy message is shown to clients when they attempt to cancel or reschedule a session. False when the message is suppressed. Null when the setting has not been configured.

cancellationPeriod.description: Deprecated. The number of seconds before a session's start time during which the cancellation policy message is shown. Superseded by `clientBookingChangesSettings`.

eventNameStyle.description: Controls how session events are labelled on the calendar. Possible values are `eventnameattendeeinitial` (e.g. Initial Consultation (M. Smith)) `eventnameattendeename` (e.g. Initial Consultation (Mary Smith)) `eventname` (e.g. Initial Consultation) `attendeenameeventname` (e.g. Mary Smith (Initial Consultation)) `attendeeinitialeventname` (e.g. M. Smith (Initial Consultation)) `attendeename` (e.g. Mary Smith) `attendeeinitial` (e.g. M. Smith). Null uses the default (`eventnameattendeeinitial`).

familyRecordBookingEnabled.description: True when clients can book sessions on behalf of family members linked to their account. False when that capability is disabled. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `true`.

hideInternalEventDetails.description: True when internal (non-session) calendar events created by the practitioner are shown without details to team members viewing the shared schedule. False when full details are shown. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `true`.

hideReferralAndReasonForBooking.description: True when the referral source and reason-for-booking fields are hidden from the client booking flow. False when those fields are shown. Null when the setting has not been configured.

invitationMethods.description: The set of calendar invitation methods enabled for this practitioner. Possible values are `internal` (Practice Better in-app invite) `google` (Google Calendar invite).

jumpToWeekOnDaySelected.description: True when selecting a date on the mini calendar view automatically jumps to the week view for that date. False when selecting a date takes no action. Null when the setting has not been configured.

oneClickBookingsEnabled.description: True when clicking on a date in the calendar view opens a prompt to create a new session for that date. False when clicking a date takes no action. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `true`.

onlineSessionPhoneRequired.description: True when clients are required to provide a phone number when booking an online (phone or video) session. False when a phone number is optional. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `true`.

reminderCalendarColor.description: The color used for reminder events on the calendar, represented as an integer ARGB value. Null uses the default (hex `FFA500`).

uninvitedClientSessionConfirmation.description: True when confirmation notifications are enabled for clients who have not been invited to access the Client Portal. False when those notifications are disabled. Null when the setting has not been configured.

webCalendarView.description: The default calendar layout shown in the practitioner portal. Possible values are `listMonth` (agenda) `agendaDay` (day) `month` (month) `agendaDayTeam` (team 1 day) `agendaWeekTeam` (team 3 day). Null uses the default week view.

weekCalendarEndTime.description: The latest time shown in the week calendar view. Events after this time are hidden unless scrolled to.

weekCalendarStartDay.description: The day of the week on which the calendar week view starts. Possible values are `sunday` `monday` `tuesday` `wednesday` `thursday` `friday` `saturday`. Null uses the default (`sunday`).

weekCalendarStartTime.description: The earliest time shown in the week calendar view. Events before this time are hidden unless scrolled to.

lastClaimsSyncStartDate.description: UTC timestamp when the most recent account-wide Claim.MD sync started (claims and ERAs).

autoReviewedJournalEntryTypes.description: The list of journal entry types that are automatically marked as reviewed when submitted by clients. Possible values are `applehealthkitnutritionentry` `applehealthkitlifestyleentry` `cronometerdiaryfoodentry` `cronometerdiarymetricentry` `fitbitentry` `garminentry` `ouraringentry`.

autoSelectJournals.description: True when journal tracking is automatically selected and enabled for new clients. False when journal tracking must be selected manually. Null when the setting has not been configured.

disableBarcodeScanner.description: True when the barcode scanner is disabled in the client mobile app for food logging. False when the barcode scanner is available. Null when the setting has not been configured.

disableNutrientClaims.description: True when nutrient claims and health labels are hidden from the food database shown to clients. False when nutrient claims and health labels are shown. Null when the setting has not been configured.

disableWelcomeVideo.description: True when the welcome video is not shown to clients when they first access their client portal. False when the welcome video is shown. Null when the setting has not been configured.

enableJournalAnalysis.description: True when clients can review their own journal entries. False when clients cannot review their own journal entries. Null when the setting has not been configured.

enableOwnerFiltering.description: True when resource lists default to filtering by the current practitioner. False when all authorized resources are displayed. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `false`.

enableProfileChangeRequests.description: True when clients can submit profile change requests that the practitioner can review and approve or reject. False when clients cannot submit profile change requests. Null when the setting has not been configured.

folderNameStyle.description: Controls how client folder names are formatted. Possible values are `lastinitial` (e.g. Smith, M. Docs) `lastfirst` (e.g. Smith, Mary Docs) `firstlast` (e.g. Mary Smith Docs). Null uses the default (`lastinitial`).

measurementSystem.description: The unit system used for body measurements in client journals and records. Possible values are `metric` `imperial`.

nameStyle.description: Controls how client names are formatted in the client records list. Possible values are `lastinitial` `lastfirst` `firstlast` `firstlastinitial` `first` `anonymous`.

singleInitialAvatars.description: True when client avatars display a single initial instead of the full initials abbreviation. False when the full initials abbreviation is shown. Null when the setting has not been configured.

welcomeVideoId.description: The ID of the welcome video shown to clients when they first access their client portal. Null if no custom video is configured.

welcomeVideoType.description: The hosting platform of the welcome video. Possible values are `youtube` `vimeo`.

actions.description: The quick action items pinned to the practitioner's home dashboard for rapid access to common tasks.

dashboards.description: The custom dashboards configured by the practitioner, each containing a named set of panels displaying practice metrics and activity.

subscriptionUsageMetric.description: The subscription usage metric displayed on the dashboard to help the practitioner track their plan limits (e.g. `storage` `charting-assistant`).

defaultCurrency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code set as this consultant's default for invoicing and billing (e.g. `usd` `cad` `gbp`). Null if the consultant has not configured a default currency.

clientId.description: The Evexia client ID that uniquely identifies the linked Evexia account. Practitioners within the same company may or may not link to the same account.

dateSynchronized.description: UTC timestamp when the last Evexia sync operation was performed. Null if a sync has never been run.

includeFhr.description: When true, Functional Health Reports are included by default when ordering Evexia lab products that support this option. Determines the default selection when creating each Evexia lab request.

payForClientLabs.description: Controls who pays for client lab tests. When true, the practitioner pays and bills clients separately. When false, clients pay Evexia directly. Determines the default selection when creating each Evexia lab request.

firstName.description: The consultant's first name as set on their practitioner profile.

legalName.description: An alternative legal name used on signed forms and documents in place of the practitioner's profile name. Null if not set.

autoCreateTreatmentPlans.description: When true, new protocols default to having the create-treatment-plan flag enabled, so that publishing a protocol that contains Fullscript supplements automatically creates a Fullscript treatment plan.

clinicId.description: The Fullscript clinic ID that uniquely identifies the linked Fullscript clinic. Practitioners on the same Practice Better team may or may not link to the same clinic.

country.description: The country in which the Fullscript account operates. Determines available products and lab panels. Possible values are `US` `CA`.

dateLabsSynchronized.description: UTC timestamp when Fullscript lab data was last synchronized with Practice Better. Null if labs have never been synced.

disableLabs.description: When true, new Fullscript lab orders cannot be created. Existing orders and plan updates already in progress are still processed.

displayTemplates.description: When true, Fullscript protocol templates are displayed when the practitioner creates a protocol from a template.

matchPatientsByEmailAddress.description: When true, existing Fullscript patients are matched to clients by email address when ordering.

notifyOnFinalResultsOnly.description: When true, lab-update notifications are only sent when a new final result is received from Fullscript. Notifications for partial updates and re-downloads of already-received final results are suppressed.

practitionerId.description: The Fullscript practitioner ID that links this Practice Better account to the practitioner's Fullscript profile.

sendTreatmentEmail.description: When true, an email notification is sent to the client when a Fullscript treatment plan is created on their behalf.

showRecommendationSuggestions.description: When true, recommended dosage hints are shown from the Fullscript product when a supplement is selected.

calendarIds.description: The list of Google Calendar IDs whose events are displayed in the Practice Better schedule view. These are the calendars imported from Google to show alongside Practice Better sessions.

hideEventDetails.description: True when Google Calendar events are visible to team members only as "Free" or "Busy" without event titles or details, protecting the practitioner's calendar privacy. False when full event details are visible to team members. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `true`.

includeClientDetails.description: True when client names are included in synced Google Calendar event titles and descriptions. False when events are created without client identifying details. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `true`.

includeSessionBufferTime.description: True when the buffer time configured around sessions is included when syncing events to Google Calendar, extending the event duration to cover the buffer period. False when the buffer time is not included and the event duration matches the session time. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `false`.

syncAvailability.description: True when availability windows configured in Practice Better are synced to Google Calendar as free placeholder blocks. False when they are not synced. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `false`.

syncCalendarId.description: The ID of the Google Calendar that Practice Better events are synced to. Sessions, reminders, and other events are written to this calendar.

syncGroupSessionPlaceholders.description: True when unconfirmed group session placeholders are synced to Google Calendar to block time and prevent scheduling conflicts. False when they are not synced. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `false`.

syncInternalEvents.description: True when personal internal events created in Practice Better are synced back to the practitioner's Google Calendar. False when they are not synced back. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `false`.

syncReminders.description: True when tasks and reminders created in Practice Better are synced to the practitioner's Google Calendar as events. False when they are not synced. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `true`.

syncSessions.description: True when confirmed sessions are synced to the practitioner's Google Calendar. False when they are not synced. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `true`. Session requests are not synced until confirmed.

useGoogleInvites.description: True when session confirmations and reminders are sent as Google Calendar invites. False when they are sent as standard Practice Better email notifications. Null leaves the consultant's current invitation method unchanged.

billingCountry.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code used for insurance billing. Controls which billing forms and code sets are available (e.g. CMS-1500 for `US`). Possible values are `US` (default when empty) `##` (unknown/non-US; relaxes US-specific requirements such as NPI and tax number).

cms1500AcceptAssignment.description: True when the CMS-1500 claim form indicates that the practitioner accepts assignment, meaning they agree to accept the insurance payer's approved payment amount as full payment. False when assignment is not accepted. Null when the setting has not been configured.

cmsServiceFacilityLocationName.description: The name of the service facility location recorded on CMS-1500 claims when the service location differs from the billing provider address.

cmsServiceFacilityNpiNumber.description: The NPI number of the service facility location recorded on CMS-1500 claims.

cmsServiceFacilityOtherId.description: The other ID value for the service facility on CMS-1500 claims, used in conjunction with `cmsServiceFacilityOtherIdQualifier`.

cmsServiceFacilityOtherIdQualifier.description: The qualifier code indicating the type of the other ID recorded for the service facility on CMS-1500 claims (e.g. "1D" for Medicaid).

defaultClaimColumns.description: The set of column identifiers shown by default in the insurance claims list view.

npiNumber.description: The practitioner's individual National Provider Identifier (NPI) number used on insurance claims.

sendSuperbillsAsAttachments.description: True when superbills are sent to clients as email attachments. False when a secure download link is provided instead. Null when no preference has been set.

setBalanceToClientResponsibilityForDenie.description: True when the client's outstanding balance is automatically set to the client responsibility amount when an insurance claim is marked as denied. False when the balance is not automatically adjusted. Null when the setting has not been configured.

superbillCompanyHeader.description: The practice name and address block printed in the header of superbills.

superbillTitle.description: The title displayed at the top of generated superbills (e.g. "Superbill" or "Receipt for Insurance Reimbursement").

taxonomyCode.description: The practitioner's healthcare provider taxonomy code that classifies their specialty on insurance claims.

useIcd10Codes.description: True when ICD-10 diagnosis codes are used on insurance claims and superbills. False when ICD-10 codes are not used. Null when the setting has not been configured.

useIcd9Codes.description: True when ICD-9 diagnosis codes are used on insurance claims and superbills instead of ICD-10. False when ICD-9 codes are not used. Null when the setting has not been configured.

acceptPayments.description: True when online payment processing is enabled and clients can pay invoices using a secure payment link. False when online payment processing is disabled. Null when the setting has not been configured.

companyHeader.description: The practice name, address, and contact details displayed in the header of generated invoices.

defaultCurrency.description: The default currency used for invoices and payments (ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. "usd", "cad", "gbp").

defaultTaxDescription.description: The label for the default tax applied to invoices (e.g. "GST", "HST", "Sales Tax").

defaultTaxPercent.description: The default tax rate applied to invoice line items as a percentage (e.g. 13.0 for 13%). Null if no default tax is configured.

disableCardDeletion.description: True when clients cannot delete a saved credit card if it is their only payment method on file. False when clients can delete their only saved credit card. Null when the setting has not been configured.

includeSignature.description: True when the practitioner's digital signature is included on generated invoices. False when the signature is omitted. Null when the setting has not been configured.

invoiceFooter.description: Custom text displayed in the footer of generated invoices, such as payment instructions or terms and conditions.

lastName.description: The consultant's last name as set on their practitioner profile.

addFaxContactsToShared.description: True when fax contacts are automatically added to the shared team contacts list. False when fax contacts are not automatically added to the shared list. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `false`.

autoSelectLastUpdatedChatSession.description: True when the chat panel automatically selects the conversation that was most recently updated when the practitioner opens the messaging view. False when the chat panel does not automatically select a conversation on open. Null when no preference has been set.

availability.description: The practitioner's displayed messaging availability status shown to clients. Possible values are `online` `away` `offline`.

chatMessageCharacterLimit.description: The maximum number of characters allowed in a single outgoing chat message from a client. Null means no custom limit is set.

clientNameStyle.description: Controls how client names are displayed in the practitioner portal. Possible values are `lastinitial` `lastfirst` `firstlast` `firstlastinitial` `first` `anonymous`.

defaultSharedChatTeamMemberIds.description: The set of team member IDs who are added by default to shared chat conversations with clients.

defaultToBlacklist.description: True when new clients are added to the messaging blacklist by default, preventing them from sending direct messages. False when new clients are not added to the blacklist by default. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `false`.

disableDelete.description: True when sent chat messages cannot be deleted by any participant. False when participants can delete their sent messages. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `false`. Once enabled, this setting cannot be disabled.

disableForegroundAlerts.description: True when foreground in-app alert banners for new messages are suppressed while the practitioner is actively using the portal. False when foreground in-app alert banners are shown. Null when no preference has been set.

disableImpromptuVideoSessions.description: True when the option for clients to start an impromptu video session directly from the chat is disabled. False when clients can start an impromptu video session directly from the chat. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `false`.

emailHeaderCaption.description: The company or practice name displayed as a caption in the header of automated client emails.

emailHeaderTitle.description: The practitioner name and credentials displayed in the header of automated client emails.

emailSenderName.description: The name shown in the "From" field of automated emails sent to clients (e.g. "Dr. Jane Smith, RD").

emailSignature.description: HTML content appended to the footer of all automated client emails as the practitioner's email signature.

enableForegroundBrowserInstantAlerts.description: True when instant browser alert notifications are shown for new messages when the practitioner is actively using the portal in a web browser. False when instant browser alert notifications are not shown. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `false`.

faxBlacklist.description: The list of fax numbers that are blocked from receiving outgoing faxes.

faxContacts.description: The list of healthcare provider fax contacts saved for this practitioner.

faxSenderName.description: The sender name shown on outgoing fax cover sheets.

groupChatNotifications.description: The notification types enabled for group chat messages. Controls which group chat events trigger alerts to the practitioner.

includeFaxCoverSheet.description: True when a cover sheet is included when documents are sent by fax. False when no cover sheet is included. Null when no preference has been set.

insecureNotifications.description: True when chat message notifications (emails and instant alerts) include the message content. False when they omit it and ask the recipient to sign in to view it. Null when no preference has been set; the setting shows as unchecked in the UI.

insecureReminderNotifications.description: True when client notes are included in the body of "reminder completed" emails sent to the practitioner. False when the email omits note content and requires the practitioner to log in to view it. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `false`.

replyToAddress.description: The email address that client replies are directed to. When set, replies to automated emails arrive at this address rather than the default Practice Better address.

sendOnEnter.description: True when pressing the Enter key in the chat input sends the message immediately instead of inserting a new line. False when pressing Enter inserts a new line instead of sending the message. Null when no preference has been set.

useLogoInEmailSignature.description: True when the practice logo is displayed at the bottom of automated client emails as part of the email signature. False when the logo is not displayed. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `false`.

useProfilePhotoInEmailHeader.description: True when the practitioner's profile photo is displayed alongside their name in the header of automated client emails. False when the profile photo is not displayed. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `true`.

createClientShoppingCart.description: When true, new protocols default to having the send-cart-to-client option enabled, so that publishing the protocol sends the client a practitioner-linked Natural Dispensary shopping cart with an optional promotional discount.

defaultPromoCode.description: The default promo code applied when creating a new protocol. Null if no default code is configured.

practitionerId.description: The email address associated with the linked Natural Dispensary account. Null if not connected.

occupation.description: The consultant's professional role or occupation as displayed on their public profile page (e.g. `Registered Dietitian` `Health Coach` `Nutritional Therapist`). Corresponds to the Professional Title field in their practitioner profile. Null if not set.

displayCompanyNameInHeader.description: True when the company name is included in the header of printed PDF forms and waivers. False when the company name is not included. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `false`.

displayContactInfoInFooter.description: True when the practitioner's contact information is included in the footer of printed PDF documents. False when the contact information is not included. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `false`.

displayDocumentIdInFooter.description: True when a unique document ID is included in the PDF footer, which can be used for auditing and reporting purposes. False when the document ID is not included. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `true`.

displaySloganInFooter.description: True when the practitioner's company slogan is included in the footer of printed PDF documents. False when the slogan is not included. Null when no preference has been set, defaulting to `false`.

logoAlignment.description: The horizontal alignment of the practice logo on printed PDFs. Possible values are `left` `lefttop` `right` `top`.

logoSize.description: The size of the practice logo on printed PDFs. Possible values are `normal` `large`.

printFormat.description: The color scheme used for printed PDFs. Possible values are `eco` (renders in black and white) `graphic` (uses the practice theme color).

professionalDesignationLetters.description: A comma-separated string of the consultant's professional credential letters, derived from their registered accreditations (e.g. `RD, CDE` `CNP, FNTP`). Null if no accreditations have been added. See [Adding Accreditations](https://help.practicebetter.io/hc/en-us/articles/234583748-Adding-Accreditations).

professionalDesignations.description: The consultant's registered professional designations, each with the accreditation name, governing body, and registration details. Null if no designations have been added. See [Adding Accreditations](https://help.practicebetter.io/hc/en-us/articles/234583748-Adding-Accreditations).
